Goods worth over R1 million seized in town centre

Police units executed search warrants at several shops in the town centre and seized suspected counterfeit and illicit goods valued at about R1.05 million.

The operation involved a provincial counterfeit goods unit, a crime intelligence team and officers from the local station, a police spokesperson said.

Share this story on WhatsApp and Facebook today

Police did not say whether anyone had been arrested or what charges might follow, and the date of the operation was not given.
